subject: Nachricht vom Studentenwerk Leipzig | Einladung zur Umfrage Wie findet ihr das Deutschlandsemesterticket?�
body:
Dear Students,
Please take note of the following message addressed by the Studentenwerk Leipzig.
Kind regards
Prof. Dr. Tobias Dauth
Rektor | Dean
Chair of International Management
_____________________________________
HHL Leipzig Graduate School of Management
HHL gemeinnützige GmbH | Jahnallee 59 | 04109 Leipzig | Germany
hhl.de
+++++++++++ For English version please scroll down ++++++++++++++
Liebe(r) Student:in,
seit Sommersemester 2024 gibt es das
Deutschland-Semesterticket – auch für die Studierenden in Leipzig
. Wie es ab Wintersemester 2026/27 in der neuen Vertragsperiode weitergeht, soll im Januar 2026 beschlossen werden. Damit der Semesterticketausschuss gemeinsam mit dem Studentenwerk Leipzig die
Interessen der Studierenden
hinsichtlich
der
ÖPNV-Mobilität
bestmöglich berücksichtigen kann, ist es notwendig zu erfahren, wie die Studierenden in Zukunft zum Deutschland-Semesterticket stehen.
Wir würden uns daher freuen, wenn Sie an der etwa
3-minütigen Befragung
teilnehmen. Auch wenn Sie den ÖPNV kaum oder gar nicht nutzen, sind Ihre Antworten wichtig für uns und liefern uns entscheidende Erkenntnisse.
Die Befragung ist unter folgendem Link bis zum
21.12.2025
abrufbar:
https://semesterticket.conomic-studie.de
Ihre Angaben werden
streng vertraulich
behandelt und die Daten
anonymisiert ausgewertet
. Ein Rückschluss auf Ihre Person ist nicht möglich.
Da es sich um eine Online-Umfrage handelt, werden die Daten automatisiert verarbeitet. Sie werden deshalb auf der Startseite hierfür um Ihr Einverständnis gebeten. Klicken Sie auf die Datenschutzhinweise, um diese im Detail zu lesen. Die Teilnahme ist
freiwillig
. Sollten sich Rückfragen ergeben, kontaktieren Sie uns gerne per E-Mail:
info@studentenwerk-leipzig.de
Sollten Sie Fragen zur Umfrage haben, können Sie sich selbstverständlich jederzeit an das Umfrageteam des Marktforschungsinstituts Conomic wenden, mit dem wir für diese Umfrage zusammenarbeiten:
info@conomic.de
Herzlichen Dank für Ihre Unterstützung!
Ihr Semesterticketausschuss im Studentenwerk Leipzig
+++++++++++++
Dear student,
The
Deutschland-Semesterticket
has been available since the 2024 summer semester –
including for students in Leipzig
. A decision on how things will continue in the new contract period from the winter semester of 2026/27 onwards is to be made in January 2026. In order for the Semester Ticket Committee, together with the Leipzig Student Services Association, to be able to take the
interests of students with regard to public transport mobility
into account as best as possible, it is necessary to find out how students feel about the Deutschland-Semesterticket in the future.
We would therefore be delighted if you would take part in this approximately
3-minute survey
. Even if you rarely or never use public transport, your answers are important to us and provide us with crucial insights.
The survey is available at the following link until
21.12.2025
:
https://semesterticket-en.conomic-studie.de
Your answers will be treated
strictly confidentially
and the data will be
analysed anonymously
. It will not be possible to identify you personally, even if you take part in the competition.
As this is an online survey, the data will be processed automatically. Therefore, you will be asked for your consent on the start page. Click on the conditions of participation & notes on data protection to read them in detail. Participation is
voluntary
. If you have any questions, please contact us by e-mail:
info@studentenwerk-leipzig.de
If you have any questions about the survey, you can of course contact the survey team at the market research institute Conomic, with whom we are working on this survey, at any time:
info@conomic.de
Thank you very much for your support!
Your Semester Ticket Committee of the Studentenwerk Leipzig

subject: Unibuddy Ambassador�
body:
Hello all,
My name is Emilia and I support HHL's Program Marketing Team.
You may recall that the HHL Marketing Team asked you during the Welcome Weeks if and how you would like to support us in our efforts to promote HHL and our programs. I am now reaching out to cash in on some of that!
You selected that you are happy to be a
student ambassador on our
website
. Thank you for volunteering, I wholeheartedly appreciate your support and I am now writing to inform you about the process.
You
, as our students, are incredibly important in our student recruitment processes. As a recent applicant, you can relate to how future students are feeling and the big decisions they will be making over the next few months.
To support candidates in their decision-making process, we introduced Unibuddysome years ago. Unibuddy is a platform that matches prospects with current students, giving them real-time access to real people with relevant interests, you might have used it yourself. Through friendly chats with prospective students, you can make them feel like they are already part of our university community.
What does this entail?
We will add you as an ambassador on our Unibuddy platform. Here, you will have the chance to create a profile so candidates with similar profiles can choose to chat with you
Prospective students can then message you via the platform.
There you can:
Answer questions they have about your student experience
Create a buzz – share your passion and enthusiasm and bring the HHL spirit to life
Redirect to certain pages or contact to us for questions you are unsure about
What’s in it for you?
You can showcase being a Student Ambassador on your CV. We will also issue a certificate stating this if you wish.
You will be contributing to the HHL community and helping to bring bright minds to future HHL classes.
You will be building your network.
Attached is the code of conduct for this. It’s pretty standard, but do let me know if you have any questions. Also remember, it is possible for us to temporarily pause your account if you feel that deadlines are piling up and you won’t be able to answer questions within a given period of time. Just give us a heads-up!
Assuming you are still in, here are the next steps:
I will add you to the Unibuddy platform in the coming days (unless you tell me you are no longer interested). You will then get an email with instructions to set up your profile etc. Then you are live and actively contributing to growing the HHL community!
☺
Read, sign and return the attached Ambassador Code of Conduct via email to me.
Use the attached ambassador guide to familiarize yourself with the task.
I hope to see you all on our platform soon. To help you get started, please also go through the
mandatory Unibuddy ambassador training and materials
here:
Getting Started as a Unibuddy Ambassador
Thank you!
Best regards,
Emilia Enderling
